notes.heading: Codification
notes.text: Section, Pub. L. 91–417, § 1, Sept. 25, 1970, 84 Stat. 868, which provided for judgment funds to be distributed in equal shares to enrolled members of the tribe, was omitted from the Code as being of special and not general application.
